name: 30306 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30306 (Atlanta) has 137 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30306 (Atlanta) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30306 (Atlanta) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30306 (Atlanta) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
